pulse.text: **Quiet three hours** — nothing shipped and no ranking moves since the overnight sweep; the AA-Index (v4.1) board still reads **Fable 5 (60)** over GPT-5.6 Sol (59), Opus 4.8 (56), GPT-5.5/Terra (55) and Grok 4.5 (54). The one live clock: **Google's Gemini 3.5 Pro is now inside its rumored Jul 17 GA window** — a ground-up rebuild with a leaked 2M-token context and a Deep Think layer — yet Google still has no model card, pricing or API listing out, and Polymarket holds the next Gemini flagship at just **71% to ship by Jul 31**. Markets are flat: **Anthropic sits ~96% for best model in July** (Google ~3%, OpenAI ~2%) and 67% for year-end, with **GPT-6 steady at 90% by Dec 31** (75% by Sep 30). The freshest threads are governance and money — **Demis Hassabis is publicly pushing a U.S.-led global AI watchdog 'before year end,'** while **Meta's Louisiana 'Hyperion' data center ballooned to a $50B, 5GW build** as executives call AI-compute demand 'almost unlimited.' Watch the **Gemini Jul 17 window** — it either resolves or slips within a day.
